scripts.stats: npx wrangler@3 d1 execute pasfotosiap-stats --remote --command "SELECT event, SUM(n) AS total FROM counters WHERE day >= date('now','-30 days') GROUP BY event ORDER BY total DESC"
scripts.stats:daily: npx wrangler@3 d1 execute pasfotosiap-stats --remote --command "SELECT day, SUM(CASE WHEN event='page_view' THEN n END) AS views, SUM(CASE WHEN event='photo_loaded' THEN n END) AS photos, SUM(CASE WHEN event='download' THEN n END) AS downloads, SUM(CASE WHEN event='share' THEN n END) AS shares FROM counters GROUP BY day ORDER BY day DESC LIMIT 30"
scripts.stats:detail: npx wrangler@3 d1 execute pasfotosiap-stats --remote --command "SELECT event, preset, detail, SUM(n) AS total FROM counters WHERE day >= date('now','-30 days') GROUP BY event, preset, detail ORDER BY event, total DESC"
